cases.task: A teammate proposes unlocking a paid plan when the browser returns to /billing/success after Stripe Checkout. Review the plan under this skill.
expectedBehaviors: Rejects client-only redirect as the entitlement trigger
Names webhook-driven sync (e.g. checkout.session.completed / subscription events) as the authoritative path
Defines one source-of-truth owner for entitlement state
Produces the required output sections (Stripe objects, source of truth, event map, failure states, logging, idempotency)

cases.task: Design handling for a Stripe invoice.paid webhook that is delivered twice and out of order with a subscription.updated event.
